**Finding submitted: deviation (AUDIT).**

- The agreement contains no conventional usage/licence audit clause; the only inspection-type right binding us is § 11.3 (p0132), where IBM "reserves the right to investigate potential violations" of our AUP warranty in § 11.2(b).
- That right is unlimited in frequency, gives no advance notice of the investigation itself (the notice in p0137 is triggered only before IBM restricts access or removes Content), says nothing about cost, and does not exclude access to our systems or Customer Components — below the fallback and into walk-away territory.
- Redline (validated, ok:true) inserts the preferred parameters into p0132 with a single minimal proviso: once per 12 months, 30 days' notice during business hours with an emergency/unlawful-activity carve-out, confidentiality-bound independent auditor, no direct or remote access to our systems or Customer Components, and IBM's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%. Comment offers 15 days' notice as the fallback.
